principles: Keep this as a metadata-only repair with no runtime behavior changes
Preserve B-6bfd evidence and lifecycle history instead of rewriting prior story artifacts
Use existing annotation contract rather than weakening convergence gates
Verify with the same user-visible command that failed
drivers: convergence_check must stop failing on annotation compliance
The fix must be auditable through a dedicated Koala story
Only three files should receive @changes metadata

options.name: metadata-only annotation repair
pros: Smallest diff and easiest to review
cons: Does not redesign the annotation system
Requires careful wording so @changes references B-6bfd checklist accurately

options.name: relax annotation gate
pros: Would avoid needing annotation repair for similar legacy gaps
cons: Weakens convergence_check and hides metadata drift
Does not address the concrete missing metadata

rationale: Choose the minimal metadata-only repair because the runtime implementation already passed B-6bfd delivery gates; the remaining failure is strictly missing @changes metadata in three @task blocks.

preMortem.scenario: Runtime behavior changes accidentally slip into this repair
preMortem.trigger: Diff includes non-comment lines or logic edits outside the annotation blocks
preMortem.consequence: A metadata cleanup becomes an unreviewed behavior change
preMortem.mitigation: Verify git diff only changes @task comment blocks in the three named files

preMortem.scenario: Annotation validator still fails after adding @changes
preMortem.trigger: @changes format lacks `- [CHK-xxx]` entries or references wrong checklist IDs
preMortem.consequence: convergence_check remains false and the story does not solve the user-visible issue
preMortem.mitigation: Run cli-validate and convergence_check before marking checklist done

preMortem.scenario: Fix uses B-ca8f in old B-6bfd annotations incorrectly
preMortem.trigger: @task remains B-6bfd but @changes references B-ca8f without context
preMortem.consequence: Annotation metadata becomes confusing for future agents
preMortem.mitigation: Use @changes entries that describe the original B-6bfd checklist coverage, and record B-ca8f as repair story in commit and evidence
